name: web-animation-interaction
description: Build interactive web experiences, gesture feedback, scroll effects, and accessible animation systems.
---
# Web animation and interaction
- Inspect existing dependencies before selecting an animation library.
- Use CSS for simple effects; use an animation library only for complex timelines or gestures.
- Keep animation state separate from application data and avoid layout thrashing.
- Provide reduced-motion behavior, keyboard alternatives, and touch-friendly targets.
- Avoid scroll hijacking, autoplay distractions, and interactions that depend only on hover.
- Test interruption, rapid repeated input, navigation, and component unmount.
